principles: Log ownership and log access are separate concepts.
Rank alone does not grant unrestricted access to private, medical, security or classified records.
The Starship Computer must enforce access before retrieval, search, playback, transcription or export.
NPCs do not gain knowledge of a log merely because the record exists.
exception_rules: A record may be voluntarily shared by an authorized owner.
Investigations may grant scoped temporary access through an explicit authority path.
Emergency access must be domain-authorized, recorded and auditable.
Death, incapacity, transfer or archival status do not automatically make a private log public.
Search results must not reveal titles/snippets of inaccessible records unless policy explicitly permits metadata disclosure.
